text:
emi: quick check — I left a small PR (link: https://git/repo/pull/1124) with a couple of tiny style changes and a suggested rename for `ctx` -> `requestCtx`. nothing big but it's blocking a follow-up refactor. can someone take a look?

jordan: on it, handing off a quick review now. is the rename just local to one file or cross-package?

emi: cross-package. mostly internal plumbing in server/ and a couple places in runtime/. i tried to keep the diffs narrow.

riley: skimmed — lgtm overall. only thing: one test imports `ctx` from the wrong path after the rename, will fail CI.

kai: if you want fast approvals run `make fmt` + `pre-commit run --all-files` — I think there's also a stray trailing comma flagged by the linter.

emi: thanks. here's the exact commands I ran locally:
```
git checkout pr/1124
make fmt
pre-commit run --all-files
pytest tests/unit/test_server.py::test_request_pipeline -q
```

sam: tagging @sam for merge permission — I can merge after CI passes and if someone else gives a quick 👍

jordan: quick nit: prefer `request_context` over `requestCtx` to match other names in pkg. small bikeshed but we should be consistent.

emi: ugh good point. i went camelCase to match some runtime names, but snake_case is more common in that package. happy to switch.

riley: +1 for `request_context`. also we have a linter rule `naming/underscore_globals` that will catch it.

ci-bot: CI queued for commit 8f7c2a1 (PR #1124). running: lint, fmt-check, unit-tests.

dev-tools-bot: suggestion: run `tools/rename-symbol --pattern "ctx" --exclude tests/ --to "request_context"` to automate cross-package renames. Preview: 7 files would be modified.

kai: nice — if you run that locally and push, bump the commit message with `co-authored-by` if multiple authors touched the rename.

emi: ran the tool, fixed the test import, rebased onto main, force-pushed. commit message: "rename(ctx -> request_context): plumbing + tests

Co-authored-by: emi <emi@redwood.com>"

ci-bot: lint failed on `server/handler.go`: trailing comma + naming/underscore_globals. See https://ci/redwood/build/98765/log for details.

riley: small fix in `handler.go`: change `requestContext` -> `request_context` in the var def and run `gofmt`.

emi: pushed fix for handler.go and ran `pre-commit` again.

ci-bot: all checks passed for commit 1a2b3c4 (PR #1124).

sam: reviewed changes, nothing functional. approving now. :+1:

jordan: approved too. can merge once the merge window opens (we're in the 11:00–12:00 UTC slot).

sam: i'll wait until 11:00 UTC and then merge. if anyone needs it earlier DM me.

emi: thanks team! sorry for the churn — better names will make follow-ups easier. :raised_hands:

kai: note for future: add a short entry to CONTRIBUTING.md about cross-package rename steps + the `tools/rename-symbol` helper to avoid manual misses.

riley: added a tiny PR template comment suggestion in review.

emi: done, created PR #1125 for the CONTRIBUTING tweak.

sam: merged at 11:02 UTC. commit 5f9d2e7 landed to main. :shipit:

emi: awesome — thanks everyone.

jordan: nice, freed up my queue.

ci-bot: deploy job started for main@5f9d2e7. monitor at https://dash/redwood/deploys/5f9d2e7

emi: will watch for any fallout in staging. ping me if you see anything.

riley: quick follow-up: added a lint exclusion for generated protobufs in a separate PR. low risk.

sam: noted. thanks again.
